summary: Iter44 — Unified Risk Correlation Engine (backend risk_engine.py + Remediations command center + Deep-Dive + Executive Briefing). Backend: 8/8 pytest PASS (~24s incl. LLM). Verified strategic (portfolio+benchmark+drift+appetite+top_risks+board_summary mentioning industry median 1.62×), tactical (dep-ecdsa task with fix_script='pip install --upgrade ecdsa && pip-audit', fix_path, exploitability, remediation_roi, blast_radius, sla_days), exposure (assets+exposure_map+appetite), compliance (items with area/rating/score/probability/impact/compliance_pct), task status transitions Open→In Progress→Remediated dropping residual_ale $9.6M→$2.88M (risk_reduced>0) then reset to Open restoring ~$9.6M, task action remediate (fix_script + connector note + ALE 9.6M→2.88M) + isolate→In Progress, advisor/insight for both 'Remediation Command Center' and 'Executive Briefing' (200 + non-empty summary/actions). Deep-dive modal opens on row click showing Who/What/When/Where/Why facets, deep-dive-scores strip, AI brief, deep-dive-script, and all 4 action buttons (execute-fix/isolate/assign-soc/accept-risk). Execute Fix fired toast 'Fix executed — ALE now $2.9M (↓ $6.7M risk reduced)', closed modal, and KPI rem-kpi-ale DECREASED from $9.6M → $2.9M (real-time recalc verified). Status dropdown → In Progress fired toast 'In Progress — ALE $9.6M'. CyberRisk page shows cyber-ale-LR-001 ($2.88M initially / $9.6M after reset) + cyber-rating-LR-001 pill. RiskRegister shows rr-rating-LR-001='Critical' + $ live figures. CRITICAL: dep-ecdsa reset to Open via API at end — verified portfolio_after.residual_ale=9,600,000.

critical_code_review_comments: risk_engine.py at 525 lines is dense but within threshold; consider extracting _exploitability/_blast_radius/_roi/_fix_path into a helpers module for clarity.

correlate() runs on EVERY /api/risk-engine/{lens} call — Remediations page loads 4 lenses back-to-back = 4 full correlations per page load. Consider a short-lived per-org memoization (5–10s TTL) since all lenses derive from the same correlate() result.

set_task_status calls correlate() twice (before + after) and task_action calls it twice as well — that's 4 heavy correlations for a single one-click action. Could pass 'before' result from first call and only recompute after the update.

board_summary uses raw ratio like '1.62×' via benchmark.strategic_recommendation but the required assertion 'mentions industry-median position' is satisfied only via the word 'industry median' which is present — good. Keep the phrase stable for tests.
rem-status dropdown is a Radix custom button (not a native <select>), so Playwright .select_option() does not work — QA must click + click option. This is documented for the next agent.
seed_data_creation: None (live_only). dep-ecdsa task status was reset to Open at end (verified residual_ale=$9,600,000 restored).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login form at /login (or root). Skip onboarding via role=button name=Skip. /app/remediations is the new command center page. rem-status-<id> is a Radix Select button, not <select> — use click + option-text click (or page.evaluate JS). Deep-dive modal is opened by clicking a rem-queue-<id> row (whole row is clickable). action-execute-fix triggers POST /api/risk-engine/task/<id>/action {remediate} and returns fix_script + connector.note + risk_reduced. IMPORTANT: any test that mutates dep-ecdsa MUST end with POST /api/risk-engine/task/dep-ecdsa/status {status:'Open'} to restore the live dataset (residual_ale ~$9.6M). Advisor endpoints take 5–15s (cached server-side); use 30s timeout.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Note: session pytest fixture must reset dep-ecdsa to Open at setup (not just teardown) because a prior test run may leave it remediated, which would make the tactical queue empty.
